keyPhrases.text: I wanted to leave at intermission
the rock portions of Larson's score were overblown and phony
surprised by my mild enjoyment of some numbers
does make some improvements on the original
low-key nebbishy charm and frisky intelligence
frequently flat and strident in their vocals
looks more like a well-fed roadie

reasoning: Mixed-negative review that acknowledges some improvements in performances but is overwhelmingly critical of the musical's fundamental flaws, weak vocals, miscasting, and structural problems. The critic admits past negative experience and remains largely unconvinced.
